To verify installed binaries, please see [here](https://github.com/IBM-Cloud/ibm-cloud-cli-release/wiki/Verify-Binaries)

### Note for Windows users: 

With this release a new certificate has been used for signing. On Windows, there may be a pop-up message `Windows protected your PC` that requires clicking `More info` and `Run anyway`. This is until Microsoft Defender sees sufficient installations with the new certificate that it accepts the reputation of the binary as [documented by Microsoft here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/package-and-deploy/smartscreen-reputation).

## Change logs

## Commands Changed
- `plugin validate` is improved to better handle flag enums and multi-line usage sections

## Bug Fixes
- `iam activity-report-create` command corrects inconsistent handling of the `--type` flag and provides deterministic output
- `iam trusted-profile-rule-create` / `trusted-profile-link-create` document additional `--cr-type` settings in the help text

## Other Changes
- Golang version 1.27.0
- IBM Cloud CLI SDK version 1.13.0
- IBM Cloud Dev plug-in version 3.5.7 (for open source vulnerability updates)
